Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Contemporary Wool Blend Area Rug, 4' x 6', Grey Charcoal
Colors: Gray/Charcoal
Materials: wool
Add energy to your home décor with this striking gray-and-charcoal rug. Its bold reimagining of the classic stripe pattern makes it ideal for a transitional-style room, and its high-height pile works well in any indoor space. 4'W x 6'L Imported. 80% wool, 20% cotton Hand-tufted geometric pattern with variable pile High .6" pile suits any indoor space Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
